source_extracts.label: Ohio SOS authentications FAQ
source_extracts.quote: The fee is $5 per document; mailed requests are processed in two to three days.

source_extracts.label: Ohio SOS Form 8003 (rev 07/2025)
source_extracts.quote: Authentication/Apostille Request Form — $5 fee, Client Service Center, 180 Civic Center Dr., Columbus, OH 43215-4138.

source_extracts.label: ORC 147.08
source_extracts.quote: Ohio notary may charge no more than $5 per notarial act.

source_extracts.quote: single sourced reseller price $300 flat; body copy reads "some intermediary services charge well over $100"
